name: Full Moon Romance
review:
Jack and Rosie at a werewolf drive-in, on 15 lines with wilds, scatters, a clone feature and free spins.

The clone feature copies symbols to help line up wins, and the free spins are the main event. With a cap of about 1,000x (1,005x exactly), medium volatility and a 96.1% RTP, it's a gentle game for relaxed sessions. The B-movie theme is a lot of fun.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
